description:
Discover native indicator/control style IDs, read-only vs interactive
        semantics, saved UI setting keys and display modes. Reports
        coarse style-family appearance hints and configurable display-only
        engineering unit fields; no rendered previews or dimensional math.
        Use before create_graph when selecting premium radar, analog/VU
        meters, LED, rotary knob or slider materials. Pages max 100 results.
        Example: list_widget_styles(kind="indicator_dial", gpu_only=true).

family.description: Only styles of this material family, e.g. Aviation, Classic, Futuristic, Glass. Empty for all.
family.title: Family

gpu_only.description: Only the GPU shader-rendered premium styles.
gpu_only.title: Gpu Only

kind.description: Only styles of this kind: indicator_dial, indicator_horizontal, indicator_vertical, indicator_led, control_knob, control_slider_horizontal, control_slider_vertical, control_button, control_switch, hydraulic_indicator or hydraulic_control. Empty for all.
kind.title: Kind

search.description: Words to search for in style ids and names.
search.title: Search
